output.one_liner: Raycast is a productivity launcher for macOS and Windows that lets users control apps, automate tasks, and access AI tools via keyboard shortcuts.
output.description: Raycast is an extendable productivity launcher that provides fast, keyboard-first access to tools, commands, and AI features. It streamlines workflows with clipboard history, snippets, window management, and thousands of community-built extensions. Designed for professionals, it integrates deeply into the OS for reliable, ergonomic use.

icp.who: Developers, engineers, and designers who rely on keyboard efficiency and automation
icp.pain: Switching between apps and repeating manual tasks wastes time and breaks focus
icp.buying_trigger: Need for deeper automation, AI integration, or team collaboration features

differentiators: AI deeply integrated into the OS workflow
Cross-platform support for macOS and Windows
Free tier with full core functionality
proof_points: Over 90k followers on X/Twitter as shown on site
Testimonials from known figures like Guillermo Rauch (Vercel) and Wes Bos
output.pricing_current: Free tier available; Pro at $8/month or $96/year; Pro + Advanced AI at $16/month; Teams from $12/user/month

signals: Regular YouTube content and changelog updates
